owner_correction: 2026-09-25: The unresolved problem is excessive detection latency. Keep the actual pattern near the observation right edge, with case-dependent context; do not add later bars merely to vary positions.
objective: Recognize the current MA dense/launch morphology as early as its visible evidence permits, with measured false alarms and misses.

withdrawn_plan.reason: R5/R8/R11 increases post-core waiting to distribute positions, contrary to the low-latency objective. Preserved as historical evidence only.

view_policy.observation_end: Use real case-specific observation prefixes around the earliest labelable state. Do not append later candles to move the target left or force three views.
view_policy.geometry: Project the original physical core into each valid crop. Do not translate labels independently, include unseen core bars, or use blank padding as evidence of earlier detection.
view_policy.position: Near-right-edge targets are consistent with the task. Broad horizontal coverage is not an acceptance goal.
view_policy.earlier_labels: A later confirmed or outcome-selected positive is not automatically a positive at an earlier prefix. Preserve visible evidence and review uncertain boundaries; uncertainty is not a negative label.
view_policy.future_review: Longer future context is for human review only, physically separate from training images and labels.
view_policy.availability: Features, MA calculation, scaling and canvas bounds must use only information available at the actual observation end. Never backdate the first detection to the historical core.

acceptance.primary: Continuous causal replay on the intended input renderer: first valid detection time relative to individually defined morphology/launch anchors, measured in bars and elapsed minutes, with misses and false alarms.
acceptance.late_detection: Record price already travelled at first detection; a late historical box match cannot stand in for early recognition.
acceptance.confirmation_dependence: Compare matched earlier prefixes and later-confirmation information to determine whether the detector needs the subsequent move. Preserve uncertain cases rather than inventing early labels.
acceptance.controls: Use real difficult non-launch/ambiguous windows under the same input convention and temporal event splits; also compare a position-only baseline. No broad-position quota or mAP-only success claim.
acceptance.remaining_work: Case-level earliest-observation examples and label semantics must be validated before defining a new build plan. No replacement dataset or model has been generated by this correction.

training_recipe_reference.init: same original YOLO11s base as both existing models;no old-checkpoint initialization without train/validation exposure audit

splits.evaluation: Common corrected val/test for A/B; exclude all unadjudicated outcome-negative rows. Positive parent event split retained; negatives require whole visible and12h safety interval inside split, and same halfyear/source as paired positive.
splits.rule: Rendered input interval and complete12h label interval confined to one split; all variants/crossvenue-timeframe event clusters share split. Earlier1200bar MA-only warmup may predate validation/test start because it is already-known history. Purge rendered/label crossing intervals; require1200warmup bars.

prior_audit_clarification: The position-only horizontal IoU baseline demonstrates a template fits the old dataset. It does not establish that near-right-edge targets are inappropriate, nor quantify actual detection false positives. Asset integrity and historical metrics remain valid only within their stated scope.
